Trump: "He [Saudi Arabia's MBS] didn't think he'd be kissing my ass... But now he has to be nice to me. You tell him he'd better be nice to me."

This is the choice the GCC will face after this war. If it moves toward deeper dependence on the US to balance Iran, they will become spineless vassals similar to Europe, who have to "kiss Trump's ass..."

Video

So thankful to CAPJ for getting John Mearsheimer and me together to talk about Trump and Israel's illegal war with Iran. Few people are as clear-eyed and elegant in their analysis as John Mearsheimer.
